headline: Denmark petitions EU to restrict Schengen access for Russian citizens
summary: In an official letter, Denmark urged EU member states to take concrete action to tighten visa issuance and Schengen access for Russian nationals.
why: Schengen area visa rules govern border freedom across 29 participating European countries.

impacts.name: Denmark
impacts.why: Restricting travel visas alters regional tourism and cross-border commercial movement.
